ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: There are 17 total bars, alternating black and white, and both the first and last bars are black. Therefore the black bars are in positions 1, 3, 5, ..., 17, giving 9 black bars total. The white bars are in positions 2, 4, 6, ..., 16, giving 8 white bars total. Let w be the number of wide black bars and n be the number of narrow black bars. The number of white bars is greater by 3 than the number of wide black bars, so 8 = w + 3, hence w = 5. Since every black bar is either wide or narrow, w + n = 9. Thus n = 9 - 5 = 4.
